purpose: Expose compounding legality and integration failures in a fixed software stress panel. No model selection, training, Elo or independent real-game generalization claim.
inputs: Eight deliberately authored opening fixtures legally replayed from the standard initial board; these are synthetic software fixtures, not acquired human games or video positions.

model_binding.selection: Frozen v3 development-selected step512; no rollout-based weight or hyperparameter changes

decision_rules.model_inputs: Native FEN tokens only; no opponent answer, scores or continuation
decision_rules.raw: Record top class and stop game as raw_illegal if it is not a legal move; do not count as chess checkmate or replace it
decision_rules.legal_mask: Record the same raw class separately and select the highest-ranked legal class; retain every masked intervention
decision_rules.draw: Stop on python-chess outcome(claim_draw=True), explicitly including immediately claimable draws
decision_rules.cap: Stop as ply_cap with result*; never relabel as a draw
decision_rules.errors: Model/adapter/opponent exceptions remain explicit failed games in the full64 denominator; unstarted games remain not_run

retention: Exact protocol bytes and source hashes before calls
Every pre-move FEN, raw decision, applied legal move and legal replay
Full PGNs, including unfinished games and non-chess termination labels
Complete game denominator and separate raw-legality, legal-mask, terminal-outcome and error counts
limitations: Designed opening panel, not a fresh acquired holdout
Opponents are bounded searches, not a calibrated rating reference
Legality masking is rule assistance and cannot establish learned rule compliance
A raw-illegal stop is an integration failure rather than a chess loss
No commentary, teaching, professional quality or sports-transfer evidence
assistance: Codex-assisted implementation and candidate evidence; preserve provenance
